For the negative endpoint x tensor y, Lean independently sums every simple z and every multiplicity coordinate mu, transports the common character coupon through that internal channel, and proves that the residual moving coupon plus the channel coupon reconstruct the two original handle coupons. This does not reuse the positive endpoint through an unrecorded mirror. Both orientations are also transported through the exact source presentation context selected by the role-aware move.

For both orientations, the internal simple z, fusion projection, character coupon on z, fusion inclusion, and quantum-dimension weight are explicit categorical Diagram syntax. Lean proves that evaluating each visible diagram gives the previously verified channel morphism. These theorems use only standard Lean logic; they do not fill or assume the remaining clean-band transport.
